issues-similar-hint: Same category, less than {{distance}} m away or at the same address
zone-empty: No territory is configured on this instance yet: create it in its administration (Scopes page).
custom-instance-help: Vigilo instance missing from the list: enter the address of its API and the name of its territory (scope), given by the association that runs it. It is kept in this browser.
custom-instance-name-help: Optional: the one of the territory otherwise.
custom-instance-remove-confirm: Remove the custom instance "{{name}}" from this browser?
custom-instance-error-scope: Invalid territory: letters, digits, "_" and "-" only (example: 34_montpellier).
custom-instance-error-https: This page uses HTTPS: the instance must too (https:// address).
custom-instance-error-unknown-scope: This territory does not exist on this instance.
custom-instance-error-unreachable: Instance unreachable or not answering like a Vigilo instance: check the address.
custom-instance-error-name: This name is already the one of an instance of the list: choose another one.
status-unapproved-long: This report will be checked soon by a moderator
status-taked-long: This report will be resolved shortly
status-inprogress-long: This report is in the process of being resolved.
status-done-long: This report appears to be resolved.
status-resolved-long: This report has been taken into account and the problem corrected!
click-edit-picture: Click on the image to edit it.
form-clear-confirm: Clear all fields and the picture?
panoramax-capture-hint: Choose a view on the map (or click elsewhere to search), browse the sequence, frame it (drag, zoom) then take the picture.
panoramax-capture-click-map: Unknown position: click on the map to look for views.
panoramax-capture-none: No Panoramax view nearby: click elsewhere on the map.
panoramax-capture-none-dates: No Panoramax view nearby for these dates: widen the period or click elsewhere on the map.
panoramax-capture-error: This view cannot be used, try another one.
solved-reports-required: You must select at least one resolved report
location-required: Please set the location of the observation on the map
photo-kept: The current photo is kept. To replace it, choose another photo.
date-required: Please set the date of the observation
map-tiles-fallback: The base map is not loading: switching to the OpenStreetMap servers.
moderation-confirm-unapprove: Remove the approval of this observation? It will go back to the moderation queue and will no longer be public.
moderation-confirm-refuse: Refuse this observation? It will no longer be visible.
moderation-done-0: Observation back in the moderation queue
moderation-failed: The moderation could not be saved, please try again.
moderator-warning:
You are about to turn on moderator mode.

1) Respect the privacy of others.
2) Think before you approve, refuse or delete an observation.
3) With great power comes great responsibility.

Continue?
install-banner-text: Add Vigilo to your home screen to open it in one tap.
install-ios-help: To install Vigilo: tap ios_share Share, then “Add to Home Screen”.
paste-hint: You can also paste an image (Ctrl+V)
photo-location-estimated: Position estimated from your phone (± {{accuracy}} m): please check it on the map.
photo-location-removed: Your phone removed the location from this photo: place the point on the map, search for the address, or take the photo directly from the app.
photo-no-location: This photo has no location: place the point on the map or search for the address.
geolocation-failed: Unable to locate you: place the point on the map or search for the address.
related-hint: Observations to resolve around this observation: same category by default, closer than the chosen distance or at the same address.
related-none: No observation to resolve with these filters: increase the distance or change the category.
stats-published-of: {{pct}} of the observations of the period
stats-when: Days and hours of the reports
moderator-instance: The key belongs to this territory ({{instance}}): another territory needs another key.
moderator-generated: Key generated: send it to the association, then save it. It will work once it has been added in the Vigilo administration.
moderator-state-pending: Key saved, not recognised by this territory yet: it will work once the association has added it in the Vigilo administration.
moderator-state-active: You are a moderator on this territory.
moderator-state-off: You are a moderator on this territory, but moderator mode is turned off on this device.
moderator-state-error: The key could not be checked (connection?).
moderator-rules: Respect the privacy of others and think before you approve, refuse or delete an observation.
moderator-delete-confirm: Remove the moderator key of this territory from this device?
drafts-hint: Photos taken with their location, on this phone. Tap a photo to create the observation.
report-issue: Report this observation to the association
moderator-text: Moderators approve or refuse the observations before they are published. To become one, contact the association managing this territory: enter the key it gave you, or generate a key and send it to the association so that it adds it in the Vigilo administration.
